Third-party scanner attribution

Binary Eye
Repository: https://github.com/markusfisch/BinaryEye
License: MIT
The scanner recognition strategy was referenced from Binary Eye. No Binary Eye application source files are copied into Qingjian.

ZXing-C++
Repository: https://github.com/zxing-cpp/zxing-cpp
Android binding: io.github.zxing-cpp:android:3.1.1
License: Apache License 2.0
The ZXing-C++ reader is used for local barcode decoding. Recognition options follow the robust scanning approach used by Binary Eye (try harder, rotate, invert, downscale, and local/global binarization).
